intent: Bind public exposure to the reviewed immutable version and retrieval content, independently of curation tier.
observable_outcome: Only reviewed current content is exposed; changes cannot inherit approval and owner access remains unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Approval matches the exact current source version, package hash and retrieval/display snapshot inspected by the operator.
New versions, changed enrichment and revocation remove eligibility; stale background work cannot attach to a newer version or restore approval.
All public discovery and material-access paths enforce eligibility, including direct IDs and creation references. Owners retain private access; approved indexed results remain possible.
Operator-only commands compare the snapshot and decision revision, atomically persisting decision, audit and outbox; stale commands conflict without changes.
Rebuild, retry and migration never manufacture approval from curated, verified, enriched or is_catalog flags; existing content requires explicit review rollout.
Preserve fixed bilingual thresholds. Measure admitted-poison ranking separately from unreviewed replacement exclusion; approval decisions require content evidence, not fixture labels.
